info.title: PrimeCare Own Client PSW Record Metadata

get.summary: Read owned provider shift logs list
get.description: Read only own client-linked PSW record metadata. Active explicit bearer, matching non-null tenant and unique actor-owned ClientProfile required. Every query binds explicit client_id and tenant_id relationships. Expose only record ID and timestamps, plus stored shiftStatus for shift logs. Stable descending ordering by start_time then id. No location, signatures, staff/provider identifiers, observations, measurements, narratives, checklist answers or care tasks. These records do not establish performed/approved care, diagnosis, medication safety, infection-control compliance or authority to act. Existing authored User compatibility routes retain their original scope. Bounded paging, exact owned detail, no-store read-only repeatable-read snapshot and source limits. No delegated access, writes or role grants.
